mapper.insert: insert into recommendation_score_daily (stat_date, member_id, candidate_type, candidate_id, score, reason_codes, rank_position, create_time) values (#{statDate}, #{memberId}, #{candidateType}, #{candidateId}, #{score}, #{reasonCodes}, #{rankPosition}, #{createTime})

choose.when: select 'activity' as candidateType, a.id as candidateId, a.name as title, a.img_url as imgUrl, 0 as score, 'cold_start' as reasonCodes, a.status, a.publish_status as publishStatus, a.del_flag as delFlag from cms_activity a where a.status = 1 and a.publish_status = 1 and (a.del_flag = 0 or a.del_flag is null) and (a.topic_id is null or a.topic_id = 0 or exists ( select 1 from cms_topic live_parent where live_parent.id = a.topic_id and live_parent.del_flag = 0 and live_parent.status = 1 and live_parent.user_status = 1)) order by a.create_time desc, a.id desc limit #{limit}
choose.otherwise: select 'topic' as candidateType, t.id as candidateId, t.name as title, t.img_url as imgUrl, 0 as score, 'cold_start' as reasonCodes, t.status, t.user_status as publishStatus, t.del_flag as delFlag from cms_topic t where t.status = 1 and t.user_status = 1 and (t.del_flag = 0 or t.del_flag is null) order by t.create_time desc, t.id desc limit #{limit}

choose.when: select s.candidate_type as candidateType, s.candidate_id as candidateId, a.name as title, a.img_url as imgUrl, s.score, s.reason_codes as reasonCodes, a.status, a.publish_status as publishStatus, a.del_flag as delFlag from recommendation_score_daily s inner join cms_activity a on a.id = s.candidate_id where s.member_id = #{memberId} and s.candidate_type = 'activity' and s.stat_date = (select max(latest.stat_date) from recommendation_score_daily latest where latest.member_id = #{memberId} and latest.candidate_type = 'activity') and not exists (select 1 from cms_topic member_only_parent where member_only_parent.id = a.topic_id and coalesce(member_only_parent.club_member_only, 0) = 1) and (a.topic_id is null or a.topic_id = 0 or exists ( select 1 from cms_topic live_parent where live_parent.id = a.topic_id and live_parent.del_flag = 0 and live_parent.status = 1 and live_parent.user_status = 1)) order by s.rank_position asc, s.score desc limit #{limit}
choose.otherwise: select s.candidate_type as candidateType, s.candidate_id as candidateId, t.name as title, t.img_url as imgUrl, s.score, s.reason_codes as reasonCodes, t.status, t.user_status as publishStatus, t.del_flag as delFlag from recommendation_score_daily s inner join cms_topic t on t.id = s.candidate_id where s.member_id = #{memberId} and s.candidate_type = 'topic' and s.stat_date = (select max(latest.stat_date) from recommendation_score_daily latest where latest.member_id = #{memberId} and latest.candidate_type = 'topic') and t.is_template = 0 and coalesce(t.club_member_only, 0) = 0 order by s.rank_position asc, s.score desc limit #{limit}

mapper.select: select 'topic' as candidateType, cms_topic.id as candidateId, cms_topic.member_id as ownerMemberId, cms_topic.city_code as cityCode, ((select count(*) from cms_topic_like l where l.data_id = cms_topic.id and l.create_time >= #{since}) + 3 * (select count(*) from cms_registration r where r.owner_type = 1 and r.owner_id = cms_topic.id and r.payment_status = 2 and r.registration_status = 2 and r.create_time >= #{since})) as popularity from cms_topic where order by popularity desc, cms_topic.create_time desc, cms_topic.id desc limit #{limit}

select 'activity' as candidateType, cms_activity.id as candidateId, cms_activity.member_id as ownerMemberId, cms_activity.city_code as cityCode, ((select count(*) from cms_activity_like l where l.data_id = cms_activity.id and l.create_time >= #{since}) + 3 * (select count(*) from cms_registration r where r.owner_type = 2 and r.owner_id = cms_activity.id and r.payment_status = 2 and r.registration_status = 2 and r.create_time >= #{since})) as popularity from cms_activity where order by popularity desc, cms_activity.create_time desc, cms_activity.id desc limit #{limit}
mapper.delete: delete from recommendation_score_daily where stat_date = #{statDate} and member_id = #{memberId} and candidate_type = #{candidateType}
mapper.insert:
insert into recommendation_score_daily (stat_date, member_id, candidate_type, candidate_id, score, reason_codes, rank_position, create_time, update_time) values
(#{s.statDate}, #{s.memberId}, #{s.candidateType}, #{s.candidateId}, #{s.score}, #{s.reasonCodes}, #{s.rankPosition}, #{s.createTime}, #{s.createTime})
on duplicate key update score = values(score), reason_codes = values(reason_codes), rank_position = values(rank_position), update_time = values(update_time)
